search_contract.prepare: Assign goal context10 tosolver210, get shared-grid vslot3 manager, set step16. Copy goal requested bounds118..124, clamp both corners8CA0A0. With clamped lowerLo and startS, cell-center origin=Lo-(trunc((S-Lo)/16)*16+Lo+8-S), per axis. Upper unchanged. Dimensions=trunc((upper-origin)/16); increment axis dimension if start cell index equals it. Allocate width*height*8 and zero. Target208=goal108. Prepare does not free a previous node allocation; observed wrappers use fresh solver then cleanup.
search_contract.begin: Call goal slot1(solver), compute world deltas/unit vectors/lengths for all8 directions. Recompute start coordinates; unsigned out-of-range jumps to goal slot2 without expansion. Otherwise make temporary64-unit eSpatialGrid cache from broad spatial query category80/filter40 over requested bounds and insert returned raw areas.
search_contract.seed: Start node g0, queuedbit30. Heap initially512 rows of16bytes, grows by doubling. Initial key distance(actual start,target). Low27 node bits track index through swaps. Pop moves last to root, heapifies, marks popped node low27=7FFFFD1, clearsbit30/setsbit31. The marker is not an object-generation field.
search_contract.visit: Popped node position=first_center+cellXY*16. Call goal slot3(point,costXMM2=g,indexR9D). True stops search, not necessarily success. If false andgoal12C, collect enclosure bits: same targetcolumn with y<=targetY sets4, y> sets8; same targetrow with x<=targetX sets1, x> sets2. AllF stops. Empty heap also stops. Always invoke goal slot2 after search, including invalid start.
search_contract.edge_terrain: For each of8 fixed directions with in-bounds neighbor: obtain heightmap through shared-grid slot2. Convert both endpoints to terrain-cell indices using trunc(float coordinate+map34/38) then signed integer division by **map58 cellsize. N=max(abs(deltaCellX),abs(deltaCellY))+1. Sample current+D/N through neighbor at N equally spaced positions, keep maximum terrainCost8AEBC0; any sample>=100000 rejects edge. Only one lateral offset (zero) is iterated: assembly advances stack-offset pointer once and immediately reaches end. Radius-related code does not add lateral terrain probes here.
search_contract.edge_objects: If terrain passed, edgeCost=maxTerrain*directionLength. Update reusable capsule C0 using current/neighbor/unit/length/profile radius; collect from temporary cache, sum object reducer8AE3A0 with outresult null and travel unit direction. Add to edgeCost. Require edgeCost<100000 before adding current g. No separate accumulated-g cutoff until goal callback.
search_contract.relax: Accept unseen node (neither queued30 nor popped31) or strictly lower g. Write g and incoming direction. Key=g+Euclidean distance to solver208 target. If notqueued insert and set30; reopening does not clear31. If queued update key and sift up/down. Finite-key equality does not swap; down chooses left on equal child keys. No explicit orthogonal-neighbor veto before diagonal evaluation.
search_contract.rng: No direct RNG draw in core search/edge sampling. Goal route reconstruction and shortcut helpers call RNG-consuming line evaluation. Geometry callees remain separate review boundaries.
search_contract.limits: No full shortest/nearest-path optimality claim. Early goal/enclosure/cost stops, goal-specific fallback and later mutable waypoint costs all affect returned route. Debug node/coverage output is bounded as logging, not a decision input.
